messages.text: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

Radar-related test capability in the passages is framed around automotive radar echo generation, FMCW radar, radar cross-section, Doppler frequency shift, hardware-in-the-loop, Open Simulation Interface, air gap, and monostatic or bistatic frontend support [2].
The R&S AREG800A radar production configurations show that radar test capability is specified by digital channel count, object count per channel, instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range, IF interfaces, remote control interfaces, and monostatic/bistatic frontend support [33].
The AREG-P1 radar mini configuration has one digital channel, one object per channel, 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range possibility, analog IF output interfaces, remote control interfaces, and requires one AREG-MFP or AREG-BFP frontend per channel [33].
The AREG-P2 radar golden configuration has two digital channels [33].
The AREG-P3 radar pro configuration has three digital channels, one object per channel, and uses AREG-MFP or AREG-BFP frontend options supporting monostatic or bistatic operation [33].
Signaling/non-signaling tester capability in the passages is framed separately around wireless communications testing, because the CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing, and fading propagation conditions [11].
The CMX500 also provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI reports, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [1].
CMX500 Callbox use cases include RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN/cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [3].
Example CMX500 Callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, multi-SIM testing, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [13].
For Wi-Fi 7 R&D, the CMX500 is positioned as a single-box signaling tester used to measure RF TX/RX characteristics in signaling mode and real-world conditions, and MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important [26].
For WLAN production, RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and the CMP180 supports Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback validation, 2x2 MIMO in one box, and scalable 4x4 MIMO using two instruments [34].
【推論】If radar development requires more simulated radar channels, objects, bandwidth, near-object behavior, or monostatic/bistatic setups, the relevant radar test equipment capability would need to scale in those dimensions, because AREG800A configurations are specified by channel count, object count per channel, 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range, IF interfaces, and monostatic/bistatic frontend support.[33]
【推論】These radar echo-generation requirements should not be treated as verified requirements for CMX500 or CMP180, because the cited CMX500 and CMP180 passages describe cellular/WLAN signaling or non-signaling RF testing rather than automotive radar echo generation.[1][11][34]
【推論】For products that combine radar with cellular or WLAN functions, signaling/non-signaling testers would cover the communications-side measurements such as RF TX/RX, sensitivity, desense, MIMO, throughput, pre-conformance, and non-signaling verification, while automotive radar echo generation remains a separate radar-specific test role.[3][13][33][34]

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S AREG-MFP]]、[[R&S AREG-BFP]] — production frontend options，支援 monostatic 或 bistatic。
- [[Automotive radar echo generation]]、[[FMCW radar]]、[[Radar cross-section]]、[[Doppler frequency shift]]、[[Hardware-in-the-loop]]、[[Open Simulation Interface]]、[[SCPI]]、[[Air gap]] — 本來源涉及的技術概念。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係
本來源已對應既有來源頁 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] 與實體頁 [[R&S AREG800A]]。本次 ingest 依同一 raw source 重新校對既有頁面，補入或修正：

- [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 的 AUX IF output、RX power output、AUX IF input 與 connector 資訊。
- [[R&S QAT100]] 搭配 [[R&S AREG800A]] 的 IF level 與 amplitude flatness 摘要。
- 讀圖補充 p001、p021、p022、p023 的低可信度註記。
- `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` 條件、RF transfer characteristics 中未完整保留 option code 的 unresolved 記錄。

本來源與其他 Rohde & Schwarz Productions 頁面（如 [[R&S SGU100A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]）同屬 test & measurement 產品資料，但用途為 automotive radar echo generation，不屬 RF signal generator 或 spectrum analyzer。

[[雷虎科技]] 是 [[0. UAV產業分析報告架構]] 中列於 [[台灣無人機供應鏈]] 下游的公司，來源描述其與軍用與大型無人機相關；[[4. UAV Eco-chain in Taiwan]] 另把雷虎科技股份有限公司列在 System Integrator 區段。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

Temporary UE capability restriction › Wait timer 與 reconfiguration
來源描述：

- 若 UE reactively requests a change of capabilities，UE expected to receive a new [[RRCReconfiguration]] immediately。
- network 可能仍短時間使用 requested resource for transmission。
- 因此引入 wait timer 等待 subsequent RRC reconfiguration。
- 若 UE 在 certain time 內未收到符合 UE current capabilities 的 reconfiguration，UE is allowed to switch its capabilities locally。

VIAVI O-RU Tester › 與 R&S portfolio 的關係
依兩份來源：

- [[VIAVI O-RU Tester]] / [[VIAVI TM500 O-RU Tester]] 主要承擔 O-DU emulation、O-RAN FH、M / C / U / S plane、test scripts、O-RU test manager / TMA 與 automation context。
- R&S 提供 RF signal generation、signal analysis、VSE、power supply、oscilloscope、RF switch / OSP、PVT360A single-box VSA/VSG 或 standalone VSA/VSG equipment。
- 2025 來源將 setup 分為：
  - [[R&S PVT360A O-RU testing]]：release / regression / quality check / production / FR1 subset。
  - VSA/VSG setup：complete WG4 and 3GPP conformance testing / R&D / FR1 / FR2 / LTE / NB-IoT。
  - [[O-RU NES testing]]：RTO6 + VSE/VSA + power supply + VIAVI TM500 O-RU Tester。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

- [[0. AI Data Center]] 是一份題為「台灣AI資料中心產業分析報告」的 OneNote raw 來源；來源正文未標示作者、發布者、正式發布日期、報告版本或資料來源清單。

- 來源主張 [[台灣 AI 資料中心產業]] 正快速成長，受惠於全球 [[AI算力]] 需求、[[生成式AI]]、[[主權AI]]、[[邊緣運算]] 與 [[Neo Cloud]] 市場崛起。
- 來源將 [[AI資料中心]] 定義為支撐 [[大型語言模型]]、[[生成式AI]] 與 [[雲端運算]] 的基礎設施，核心包含高效能 [[AI伺服器]]、[[GPU]] / [[TPU]]、[[液冷系統]] 與高速網路。
- 來源列出市場數字：2025 年全球伺服器出貨量預估達 1,432 萬台，[[AI伺服器]] 占比預估 2029 年達 38.4%；來源未附引用、計算口徑或資料機構。
- 來源稱 [[微軟 Azure]]、[[Vantage]]、[[是方電訊]] 等業者已在台啟用資料中心，帶動本地基礎建設與供應鏈需求；來源未提供啟用日期、機房位置、容量或原始公告。
- 來源將供應鏈分成上游晶片與零組件、中游伺服器代工與品牌、下游雲端與 AI 服務，列名包含 [[台積電]]、[[信驊]]、[[雙鴻]]、[[台達電]]、[[金像電]]、[[緯穎]]、[[鴻海]]、[[廣達]]、[[英業達]]、[[台智雲]]、[[AWS]]、[[Google Cloud]] 等。
- 來源稱 [[緯穎]] 為 AWS、Meta 代工；稱 [[鴻海]] 與輝達合作；來源未提供合約、客戶公告、出貨或專案證據。
- 技術面，來源列出 [[液冷散熱]]、[[DLC]]、[[兩相液冷]]、高效率電源與儲能系統、模組化設計、GPU 叢集與 [[BMC]] 遠端管理。
- 政策與挑戰面，來源列出能源供應、用電規範、綠電、碳排、個資法、資安法規、人才流失、技術斷層與國際競爭。

信驊 › 來源中的列名
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 4]]（圖上標示 2026 年；取得於 2026-09-04）在「台股 AI 電力供應鏈地圖」的「PMIC 設計與 BMC 監控」分類中列出 [[信驊]]。
- 同一分類還列出 [[矽力-KY]]、[[致新]]、[[力智]]、[[茂達]]、[[BMC]]、[[新唐]]。
- 來源未提供 [[信驊]] 的產品型號、客戶、BMC 型號、營收、市占率、供應合約、認證或出貨資料。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

VIAVI O-RU Tester › March 2025 short version 中的新增角色
依 [[R-S-portfolio-for-O-RU-testing_MARCH_2025_R-S_INTERNAL_ONLY_SHORT]]（March 2025）：

Radar-related test capability in the passages is framed around automotive radar echo generation, FMCW radar, radar cross-section, Doppler frequency shift, hardware-in-the-loop, Open Simulation Interface, air gap, and monostatic or bistatic frontend support [2].
The R&S AREG800A radar production configurations show that radar test capability is specified by digital channel count, object count per channel, instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range, IF interfaces, remote control interfaces, and monostatic/bistatic frontend support [33].
The AREG-P1 radar mini configuration has one digital channel, one object per channel, 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range possibility, analog IF output interfaces, remote control interfaces, and requires one AREG-MFP or AREG-BFP frontend per channel [33].
The AREG-P2 radar golden configuration has two digital channels [33].
The AREG-P3 radar pro configuration has three digital channels, one object per channel, and uses AREG-MFP or AREG-BFP frontend options supporting monostatic or bistatic operation [33].
Signaling/non-signaling tester capability in the passages is framed separately around wireless communications testing, because the CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing, and fading propagation conditions [11].
The CMX500 also provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI reports, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [1].
CMX500 Callbox use cases include RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN/cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [3].
Example CMX500 Callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, multi-SIM testing, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [13].
For Wi-Fi 7 R&D, the CMX500 is positioned as a single-box signaling tester used to measure RF TX/RX characteristics in signaling mode and real-world conditions, and MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important [26].
For WLAN production, RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and the CMP180 supports Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback validation, 2x2 MIMO in one box, and scalable 4x4 MIMO using two instruments [34].
【推論】If radar development requires more simulated radar channels, objects, bandwidth, near-object behavior, or monostatic/bistatic setups, the relevant radar test equipment capability would need to scale in those dimensions, because AREG800A configurations are specified by channel count, object count per channel, 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range, IF interfaces, and monostatic/bistatic frontend support.[33]
【推論】These radar echo-generation requirements should not be treated as verified requirements for CMX500 or CMP180, because the cited CMX500 and CMP180 passages describe cellular/WLAN signaling or non-signaling RF testing rather than automotive radar echo generation.[1][11][34]
【推論】For products that combine radar with cellular or WLAN functions, signaling/non-signaling testers would cover the communications-side measurements such as RF TX/RX, sensitivity, desense, MIMO, throughput, pre-conformance, and non-signaling verification, while automotive radar echo generation remains a separate radar-specific test role.[3][13][33][34]
